summary: Round 3 (no box yet: the budget pace funds one box for the fleet and another branch holds it). Built and CPU-tested the search -> curriculum loop inside the trainer: --auto-beam N (beam_tas from the map start when the greedy eval passes the spine's success line; the frontier line cut at its last contact before its deepest point becomes the spine) with an --auto-ge M Go-Explore fallback, and beam_tas --start-state. Gate 8 (the 20.4% catch) analysed: the policy free-falls from a take-off at 17.46% with ~100 u less energy than the record, below the ramp series the record surfs; local GE (1.9M runs) and a 256-env CPU beam do not cross it. Next: the first box run = incumbent + beam12 flags + --auto-beam 4096 --auto-ge 10.
